findings.motion: third reading and adoption of SJR 37, constitutional amendment clarifying that a voter must be a United States citizen (Record 2196, 102 Yeas, 14 Nays, 22 Present not voting)
findings.note: Listed among the Yeas on the House vote adopting SJR 37.

Sole author. Bill: an elective course on community safety and firearm safety for certain public high school students. Last action on the House member list: referred to Public Education on 2025-03-07; date given is that referral, not the filing date.

One of three authors (Harris, Manuel, Spiller). Bill: collection and confidentiality of information about firearms in agency foster homes, with a civil penalty. Member list shows it effective 2025-09-01; date given is the list's 2025-06-20 action.

One of two authors (Turner, Manuel). Bill: prosecution of the offence of possessing or carrying certain weapons in facilities or residences serving people with intellectual or developmental disabilities. Date is the referral action on the member list, not the filing date.
